result.summary: Adds unit tests across four script test suites to cover edge cases and boundary conditions in src/script/script.cpp. The new test cases exercise CScript::IsPayToTaproot(), CScript::GetSigOpCount(), CScript::IsPayToAnchor(), CScript::HasValidOps(), CScript::GetOp(), and CScriptWitness::ToString().
result.problem: Boundary checks and error paths in core script parsing, classification, and sigop counting lacked targeted unit test coverage, allowing 12 live mutants to survive undetected in src/script/script.cpp.
evidence: Author description and commit messages demonstrate 12 specific live mutations in src/script/script.cpp that previously survived and now fail newly added assertions (PR description, commits accf04f6ee, 20d01e52a4, 5eb9407e52, 448176c749)
result.scope_notes: Test-only change across four unit test files.
result.changed_since_previous: Rebased without substantive changes to test coverage.
result.card: Adds unit tests across four script test suites to kill 12 live mutants in src/script/script.cpp identified through automated mutation testing. The additions exercise edge cases in Pay-to-Taproot script recognition, Pay-to-Anchor payload byte validation, SigOp counting boundary opcodes, opcode limits in HasValidOps, truncated pushdata handling in GetOp, and witness stack string formatting. Only unit test files are modified.

risk.why: Touches only unit tests; any bug would merely produce false positive test failures during test execution.
